query: SELECT ogp.operatorId, o.name, ogp.permissionKey, ogp.enabled FROM operator_granular_permissions ogp JOIN operators o ON o.id = ogp.operatorId WHERE o.name IN ('Thalita', 'Thiago') AND ogp.permissionKey LIKE 'fin.%' ORDER BY o.name, ogp.permissionKey;
